shots.js: (()=>{const imgs=[...document.images].map(i=>[i.getAttribute('src'),i.complete&&i.naturalWidth>0]); const a=[...document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="tel:"],a[href*="wa.me"]')].map(x=>x.getAttribute('href').slice(0,40)); const f=document.querySelector('.hero-figure').getBoundingClientRect(); return JSON.stringify({imgs, links:[...new Set(a)], form:!!document.querySelector('form'), fallbackVisible:document.querySelector('[data-form-fallback]').offsetHeight>0, fig:[f.left|0,f.top|0,f.right|0,f.bottom|0], docW:document.documentElement.scrollWidth, css:getComputedStyle(document.body).fontFamily.slice(0,30)})})()
